project.purpose: Natural source owner of external authority identity/currentness, deterministic discovery and read-only CLI; no universal registry, permissions or domain truth.

nodes.label: ExternalAuthorityRecordAndObservationCatalog
nodes.responsibility: Validate versioned external-authority identity records and independently supplied currentness observations, and derive a disposable, source-provenanced discovery index for task-local method and source selection.
nodes.authority: External Authority Catalog source and observation discovery only; normative truth and permissions remain with external issuers
outputs: validated source/revision-aware external authority records and a rebuildable discovery projection
source-qualified failure/UNKNOWN when an observation is missing
nodes.behavioralContract: The index is reproducible from current admitted authority records; it cannot invent task-specific applicability, issue permissions, lift observation freshness to installed execution truth, or overwrite external normative authority.
acceptance: Native catalog validator consumes source records, append-only observations, disposable index; tests verify deterministic score and discovery without claiming task applicability.
formalObligations: Latest indexed record and observed-currentness inputs must remain distinct from current authority/provider truth.
Authority candidate existence must not imply consumer-specific applicability, consent or formal satisfaction.
replacements: Reuse standards-native authority discovery or external KB solutions if they preserve deterministic source/provenance/observation separation.

slices.label: SourceQualifiedExternalAuthorityDiscovery
acceptance: Independent authority source/observation catalog consumer identified; no production/installed authority claim.

nonClaims: Catalog source/observation identity does not establish external issuer normative currentness, installed state, applicability or certification.
NX01 source identity retained after physical relocation; Next cross-domain binding remains independent.
